name: Real Estate Photoshoot
description: Professional real estate photography project from staging to final delivery, including photography, video, drone, 3D animation, and web delivery.

children.name: Client consultation & briefing
children.description: Discuss property details, shot list, and client expectations

children.name: Property scouting & scheduling
children.description: Visit property, plan shots, schedule shoot times

children.name: Equipment preparation
children.description: Check cameras, lenses, drones, lighting, batteries

children.name: Staging coordination
children.description: Coordinate with stager, finalize property presentation

children.name: Exterior photography
children.description: Front, back, sides, landscaping, architectural details

children.name: Interior photography
children.description: All rooms, wide angles, detail shots, ambient lighting

children.name: Twilight photography
children.description: Exterior twilight shots with interior lights on

children.name: Drone/aerial photography
children.description: Aerial property shots, neighborhood context, roof condition

children.name: Video walkthrough
children.description: Cinematic property walkthrough video

children.name: Floor plan creation
children.description: Measure and create 2D/3D floor plan

children.name: 3D virtual tour capture
children.description: Matterport or similar 3D scan of property

children.name: Detail & feature shots
children.description: Close-ups of finishes, appliances, fixtures

children.name: Photo culling & selection
children.description: Select best shots from all captures

children.name: Photo editing & retouching
children.description: Color correction, HDR blending, sky replacement, staging cleanup

children.name: Video editing
children.description: Color grading, transitions, music, titles

children.name: 3D animation & virtual tour
children.description: Process 3D scan, create virtual tour, add hotspots

children.name: Drone photo/video editing
children.description: Stabilize, color grade aerial footage

children.name: Proof gallery creation
children.description: Create online proof gallery for client review

children.name: Client review period
children.description: Client reviews and requests edits

children.name: Revision & adjustments
children.description: Make client-requested edits

children.name: Final image export
children.description: Export high-res and web-ready images

children.name: DTP & marketing materials
children.description: Create flyers, brochures, social media assets

children.name: Web & portal upload
children.description: Upload to MLS, Realtor portals, client website

children.name: Client delivery
children.description: Deliver final files, archive project

risks.title: Weather cancellation
risks.mitigationPlan: Schedule backup shoot day, monitor weather forecasts
risks.notes: Outdoor shoots and drone flights weather-dependent

risks.title: Drone flight restrictions
risks.mitigationPlan: Check airspace restrictions, obtain LAANC authorization
risks.notes: Verify no-fly zones and altitude limits near property

risks.title: Equipment failure
risks.mitigationPlan: Carry backup camera, batteries, memory cards

risks.title: Property not ready
risks.mitigationPlan: Confirm staging completion day before, have stager contact
risks.notes: Sellers may not complete prep work on time

risks.title: Client scope creep
risks.mitigationPlan: Clear contract with defined deliverables, charge for extras
risks.notes: Clients often request additional shots or edits

risks.title: Editing backlog
risks.mitigationPlan: Batch similar projects, use editing presets
risks.notes: High season can create editing bottlenecks
